added_failure_source: The source manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite and its exclusive paths contain no test file; the only declared gate log is census-planted.log, which ends EXIT=0. Zero and an empty id list therefore mean no test failures were recorded, not a measured before/after suite delta.
assertion_analysis: At sib-consistency-census-run.py:703-744 the planted family is independently known to be divergent: suppressing family reports, collapsing the two base-phrase variants, or collapsing template features makes the corresponding detection or count check fail.

Reporting the known identical planted pair makes identical_family_not_reported false; breaking the concept regex or collapsing the two known formula texts makes planted_concept_detected or planted_concept_definition_variants fail.
Returning an empty family definition or template makes the planted proposal checks fail; leaving any reported family without one makes proposals_complete false and main exits non-zero.

These checks compare results with planted facts and fixed expectations, not values passed through as inputs; the internal proposals_complete aggregate is not an independent coverage check for omitted live families. The control does not catch the pronoun lemma defect at line 72.

findings.description: The concept regex captures pronoun-led 'It is defined by' text as the concept lemma 'it'; the committed JSON records 36 divergent definitions for it and the HTML includes it among the largest divergent concepts. The planted control never exercises this false-positive case, so the live census presents a pronoun as a shared catalog concept and can misdirect the consistency pass.
